conventions.e_PD: e_PD[n] = u[n] - x_v[n],  x_v = L(z) g(e_PD)  =>  e_PD = H_PD u, H_PD = 1/(1+L)
conventions.comparator: q[n] = sign(e_PD[n] + v[n]), v ~ N(0, sigma_v^2)
conventions.lms: w_g += mu_g mean(q c[n-D]);  w_k += mu_p mean(q 1{p[n-D]=k})
conventions.S: S_ij = dE[G_i]/dtheta_j, theta = [w_g*Delta, w_0..w_7] (ps); reported normalised S_norm = S*sigma_v/sqrt(2/pi) (dimensionless); restoring <=> eig(-S_norm) on the observable subspace has Re>0; mS_gg = -S_norm[g,g]
